convertibility_reason: SuperTrend indicator now supported by generator. Standard ATR-based Kolier_SuperTrend with single instance.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timing

other_exits: Opposite SuperTrend signal closes position (Up signal closes sell, Dn signal closes buy)
Trend direction close: if UpTrend buffer is active (no UpSignal but UpTrend), force close sell; symmetric for buy with DnTrend buffer

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM input=fixed lots; Positive MM input=risk percent of free margin

custom_logic_notes: Signal is evaluated on bar index SignalBar (default=1, previous closed bar). The EA uses 4 buffers from the Kolier_SuperTrend indicator: buffer 0=Up trend line, buffer 1=Dn trend line, buffer 2=Up signal (non-empty on buy signal bar), buffer 3=Dn signal (non-empty on sell signal bar). Secondary close check: if no signal but trend direction buffer confirms opposite trend, force close position. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans allow independently enabling/disabling long/short entry and exit.
python_conversion_notes: Standard ATR-based SuperTrend with period=10, multiplier=3.0. Entry on direction flip signals (buffer 2/3). Secondary close on trend direction confirmation (buffer 0/1). Signal bar offset of 1 means trades are on confirmed bars.
